nom: ILIA Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 with 8-Hour Oil Control

avis.titre: it has an ingredient that makes my skin itch
avis.texte: I did want to love this. It is light and has 50 sunscreen. However, after wearing several times, I realized I had developed an intense red, itchy rash every single time I used it. However I used the previous ILIA serum foundation (SFP 40) for a couple of years prior to this and it did not cause the irchy rash. The smell of the old serum one is PUTRID - llike slugs or someting horrible and slimy. I was hoping to replace the smelly one with this new one, but alas it does not agree with my skin.

This is my new favorite sunscreen. It doesn't make my skin feel greasy, and it doesn't cause me to break out. I layer this spf under Ilia's super serum skin tint, and the combination is still nice and light weight. Highly recommend, especially if you have oily or combination skin like me
As soon as I squirted this onto ny fingertips, I knew it wouldn't apply it to my face as the Light to Medium shade is far too dark to work on light complexions. I'm sticking with Tatcha.

I feel that this sunscreen is good. It absorbs into the skin leaving a light dewiness. It does not get sticky or greasy. I was able to apply makeup over it with no problem. I was sent the incorrect shade so I am not able to speak on the coverage. The dark shade did leave a tint on my skin so I will need to try the correct shade. Overall I do like that its a serum sunscreen and it helps protect your skin with or without makeup.

I received a free sample of this sun serum from PinchMe. The shade was a bit dark for my skin, but I liked that it was lightweight and didn't irritate my skin or cause breakouts (which often happens to me with sunscreen).

This is a super lightweight tinted sunscreen and a mineral sunscreen at that. It blends readily into your skin and afterwards your skin, well, still feels like skin. I've got mature skin that breaks out due to HRT. This product gives a hint of coverage without clogging pores or causing additional acne. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: A must try for combo/oily skin girlies!
avis.texte: I've been loving this Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF with 8 hour oil control. As a combination skin girly, it definitely helped control the oil on my face throughout the day all while protecting me from the sun with the SPF coverage! I love the packaging, it's super cute and travel friendly. Nice texture and easy to apply. Went on smoothly under makeup. I've had no problems so far!
I wad so happy to see this come out. I ordered a bottle and the day I received i immediately ordered another.
I find this very drying on my skin and I expected the tint to have more coverage. I am disappointed and won't purchase again,

I absolutely love this sunscreen. I used it everyday since I bought it. It goes under makeup beautifully. Does not leave a greasy film or a white cast. I wish it came in a larger size. It is pricier than the K beauty I use but I will cont on use to buy it.
I love the spf. It's not oily but face feels moisturized. I use it after the face milk. My nose is oily at baseline. Doesn't seem to make an oiler.
As a minimal to no makeup girlie , I loved this! Didn't feel greasy or cakey and evened my skin just a bit while protecting me from the sun
This stuff feels great on my skin. The texture is smooth and blends perfectly. It doesn't leave a white cast or chalky feel like a lot of mineral SPFs do.
Love the screen protection, but didn't see much color when applied! I purchased lite/medium. Must be more medium/dark!
Ill a is light on the face for all year round I love Ilia sunscreen serum . It is the best
This is super lightweight, not greasy, unscented, and blends like butter. I really like the light tint it offers. My only wish is that it becomes waterproof.
the most lightweight easy to apply tinted sunscreen ive tried. evens skin tone gives a glow and protects the skin
The is one of the best sunscreen I've ever had. It's so light on my screen yet the protection is amazing. I'm obsessed with every Ilia products.

avis.titre: Great four protection from the sun
avis.texte: Overall, I really liked this product. It is convenient to use. It is a lightweight somewhat hydrating skin tint that is forgiving. It wasn't quite hydrating enough for my dry skin to use alone, but it did a great job at protecting my skin from the sun after being out all day. I think this would be a perfect product for somebody with normal to oily skin and not a bad option for somebody with dry skin with the understanding that you may need additional hydrating options. I received this item as a part of a promotion in exchange for my honest feedback.

I tend to shy away from foundation because it's too heavy for my liking. When I saw ILIA made a tinted sunscreen I immediately got my hands on it. Not only is it oil controlling it stays in place. Oh, and I layer it on to ensure I'm evenly covered without issue.
Great SPF but I should have going lighter for my skin tone. It just gave me a perfect tan.
I really like this Sunblock! Easy to apply with just a hint of color. My only complaint is that there is just the tiniest bit of gritty feeling. Nevertheless I use it every day!
I like how it doesn't make my skin feel so greasy not shiney. It's like a natural glow and makes my skin look more alive
Don't even worry about choosing the "shade" this has no color at all. It is shiny, but probably good protection for our skin.

Headed to Puerta Vallarta at the end of July and I am sooooo excited to take this with me. I have only used it once so far to do a trial and I love it. Blends in beautifully and is light and no strong smell or heaviness. Its as amazing as all the other Ilia products I love.
This super lightweight sunscreen doesn't leave a smudged effect; for me, it's perfect to wear under makeup. It feels hydrating but not greasy. This has become my favorite.
Love it , it don't make your face feel greasy! And I can wear it under my make up it by it self. Truly love it

I have a lot of sunscreens, but ever since I got this one, they've all taken a back seat. The lightweight texture is everything, never greasy, comfortable to wear, and it keeps my skin looking fresh while staying hydrated. I also love the subtle tint, which gives just the right amount of coverage for no makeup days. Definitely a repurchase for me. ☀️✨

I had a received a free ILIA Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50. ILIA Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen is a great product for a few reasons. The product is lightweight and oil free. It easy to apply my makeup over the serum. The color matched my skin tone well. The ingredients are natural and simple. One thing that I didn't care for was the scent, even though it is fragrance free, I can still smell something and would rather have had a scent to it.

I received this product for free in order to leave a review. I enjoyed the product, it didn't break me out and didn't leave me super greasy like my typical tints do. Nice coverage, sheer so would need built upon for medium coverage. I would like to try on one shade lighter to get an idea of my preference.

avis.titre: Love how it looks so natural and gives me a balanced look
avis.texte: I'm a minimalist lately with makeup and I love this tinted SPF cream and I plan on using it instead of foundation or a BB or CC cream! It hydrates my skin and evens out my complexion. It's two thumbs up 👍 for me!
I received this item as a free sample. I loved this product. I do not like normal sun block/screen scents, and this one really wasn't that bad.

Nice serum textured sunscreen. No harsh scent and very dewey, but not overly greasy. I'm honestly not sure why it's tinted because although there's no white cast, there's also absolutely no coverage. That's absolutely fine for certain days & folks with great skin. I enjoy it with just some powder & concealer on low maintenance days. Can't speak to any bonafide skin improvements, as I'm not using it consistently. overall, I like it, but probably would not repurchase for the price and would opt for something with more coverage.

avis.titre: A must have for your daily routine
avis.texte: I received this product for free. I have combination skin and at 38 years old, spf is so important! This worked very well on my skin and didnt cause any irritation or issues. I felt it definitely helped to improve my skin and was so lightweight! I will be purchasing this!
I bought this as an alternative for beach / pool days….but I feel my everyday skin tint does just a good of job of sun protection with better coverage. And this makes my face pitch.
My skin is responding quite well to this sunscreen. I'm using it on my face when I garden, and when I've at the beach. It works.

Every time I used the product my skin broke out. This concerned me so I put the ingredients list into ChatGPT and received information back that stated at least five of the ingredients could be causing the same day breakouts: niacinimide, polymers, esters, etc. I find when I try to use a dual purpose sunscreen it usually causes issues. The product is trying to do too many things and the ingredient combination along with being outside and usually in warmer weather causes reactions. I'll be going back to a neutral sunscreen product.
Really loving this new serum mineral sunscreen spf 50! It works great as a makeup primer, and also calms any irritation or redness. It reapplies well too! Highly recommend!
I love this sunscreen! It is very lightweight, yet very hydrating. This is the perfect sunscreen for a sun-kissed glow. It blends in beautifully and looks very natural

This is hands down my favorite sunscreen ever! It had a beautiful, light, gel-serum texture. I love how it looks great under makeup and prevents oiliness, leaving my skin looking great even after a long workday. My only suggestion is updated packaging, since I find you have to push quite hard to get the product out. Still 5 stars for me!

I don't think I would buy this product again. I assume it works OK. I don't find it better than other sunscreens I use on my face. Just like any other sunscreen I don't like the feel of it on my skin. It doesn't do anything for my complexion either.

I love that my ILIa sun serum brought a glow to my face to wear it looks so pretty. It's not thick or feel thick on your face. It's the perfect makeup for summer time not heavy and also protects your skin

I've been really liking the ILIA Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50. The texture feels more like a lightweight serum than a typical sunscreen, so it goes on smoothly and doesn't feel heavy or greasy. It gives a natural finish with a subtle glow, and it layers well under makeup without pilling. I also like that it helps control oil throughout the day while still keeping my skin comfortable and protected.
I am loving this sunscreen. It feels lightweight and applies like skincare rather than a heavy, sticky sunscreen. Will definitely repurchase.

I received a free ILIA Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 with 8-Hour Oil Control from ILIA to try. I really like that it does not feel heavy like normal sunscreen does. It glides on very nicely and is comfortable to wear. It also does not have a sunscreen smell, so that is nice. Overall, this is a great product, and feels like you're doing something nice for yourself.

I really wanted to love this sunscreen because I adore ILIA products and the texture is beautiful—very lightweight, serum-like, and it blends into the skin so easily without feeling heavy or greasy. It also gives a nice natural glow and sits well under makeup. However, on my sensitive skin I did notice a slight stinging sensation after a few uses. It's not severe, but I am usually quite sensitive so I think my skin may not fully tolerate some ingredients in the formula. I appreciate that it's mineral-based and feels elegant to apply, but I would say it may not be the best choice for very reactive skin types. Overall, it's a beautiful formula cosmetically and feels like skincare + sunscreen in one, but just something to keep in mind if you have sensitive skin like me.
Nice if you want just a light tint and not a full makeup base. Nice sunscreen. Goes on smoothly.
Thus sunscreen has just a hint of color so it goes on with a natural look.

I love this so much! The shade was perfect and blended In really well, it doesn't leave your skin feeling greasy like sunscreen on your face usually feels, the shade is perfect and still allows me to feel natural since I don't wear much makeup. I really love this! I received this for free in exchange for my honest opinion.
Simple, easy, looks good, feels good, good ingredients. Exactly what I was looking for this Summer while I usually wear a lighter cover of makeup during this season.

Im in LOVE with this sunscreen. It goes on beautifully and looks so natural. I find it very very hydrating. It leaves me with a glowy, youthful looking sheen. It goes on clear and i like how lightweight it feels. This is the perfect sunscreen for my sensitive skin. I will definitely be buying this time and time again. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I loved this makeup tint. I applied it in the morning and finished my day with a flawless finish. My makeup looked natural throughout the day, and I didn't experience oily skin. What I loved most is that I can protect my skin with SPF 50 while wearing makeup.
I have truly, enjoyed using the mineral sunscreen and have told my girl friends about it that they too, have bought the product :-}
I bought the medium/dark. I was concerned it would be too dark right out of the bottle, but it adjusts to you skin tone. It gives a nice bronze glow. It is perfect for the hot, humid Florida summer.

I don't go out without sunscreen and this is just a step up from bare skin, for a no makeup day. I also like it under the stick foundation, which is what I really wanted it for! Thank you for adding more sunscreen products. Its hard to find a good mineral face sunscreen. Although I love my serum, this is not as glowy, and in humid weather I really appreciate less shine.
I apply the sunscreen every morning before applying the remainder of my makeup. It goes on soft and smooth and I feel really great that I know I'm protecting my skin.

I have a positive experience with the Ilia mineral sunscreen SPF 50, this super seamless serum don't clog my pores and leave my skin hydrated, no rashes or sensitivity with the combination other products. Love the slight tint that provide in days when no make up, adorable shade and skin care. Effective balancing and shine control product that I carry in my purse this summer, highly recommend.

Really loving the Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen with SPF 50. I have really oily skin, but this gives me a healthy glow all while protecting me from the sun. Goes on light and smooth. Will definitely be adding this to my daily routine.

I received this as a free gift with other purchases so I tried it. I actually love the texture of this sunscreen - it feels like you are putting on moisturizer. It's slightly tinted but it doesn't really provide any coverage. I've been using it pretty consistently since receiving as it's getting warmer and I haven't been sun burned yet!
Oh my gosh, thank you so much, PINCHme. I will absolutely be purchasing this!
It goes on smooth but it really intensifies fine lines even though I used lots of face milk before applying it.

avis.titre: Good product, container can be improved
avis.texte: It is pricey for the quantity. The tint blends in well. I carried this on a plane and the product leaked and spilled in my travel pouch. The lid can definitely be improved.
I thought I had found my favorite sunscreen until I tried this. It feels like skincare and goes on so smoothly. It is my new favorite!

This works great! It's not greasy, it doesn't stink, and it doesn't cause breakouts. And unlike most other mineral sunscreens I've tried, I don't feel that icky greasy residue on my face after washing it. I've always felt forced to choose between the awful white cast most mineral sunscreens give you or the overpowering orangish undertones of the average tinted sunscreen, so it's a relief to finally wear a sunscreen that is light and sheer yet strong. I don't have to choose between looking and feeling my best! I will say I don't love how small it is for the price. I'm curious to see how long this will last with near daily wear.

avis.titre: I love Ilia Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen
avis.texte: I really loved this mineral sunscreen. Went on smooth and loved that it was tinted.

avis.titre: Like the product - don't like the bottle
avis.texte: I like the overall feel of the product. It's not heavy or greasy. But I really don't like the bottle it's in and the way you have to squeeze it out, making it hard to get the same consistent amount to apply every time. For the price I feel like the size is small and I always use a little too much with how you have to squeeze it so I feel like I'll go through it really fast.

I got this product free from PinchME to try & I loved it! - Its absolutely perfect for summer- Packaging is precious, such a fun addition to my bag for the beach. Product isn't greasy. This is my new summer fav!!
I use sunscreen every day, regardless of the weather, and this one was incredibly light and went on smoothly. It did look dewy, but I like a dewy finish, so that did not bother me at all.

I have been using the Sun Serum Mineral sunscreen and ai absolutely love it! Not too think and does not leave any white cast as the formula is tinted. Feels light on the skin. Helps to control oil throughout the the day while protecting your skin from the sun. Can feel good about using it everyday since it it mineral based. Has become a staple in my morning makeup routine.

As someone that is 40+ I was surprised by how well this worked. It goes on so smooth and sinks into your skin. Without falling into creases and lines. A product that makes you look good while protecting you skin 👌
I received this product from pinchme. It's creamy and light makes my skin feel moisturized. And with sun protection.
I received this product to try for free. While not a fav, it did do it's job for me in covering blemishes. The SPF protection is also a nice bonus.

I received Ilia's Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 as a sample free of charge in return for an honest review. I am very particular when it comes to my skincare and sunscreen choices. This sun serum is a real hit for me. It goes on very smooth and just seems to sink into my skin. The serum feels very light on my skin. With the weather getting warmer, I just use this serum rather than a full face of makeup. I love it and plan on keeping it in my skincare routine. I love make up with SPF in it as I don't have to have multiple layers of products.

Thanks PinchMe for the complimentary product. I really like this sunscreen it's provides a high grade spf and it helps hold back my oils with its soft matte finish. The medium deep shade works like a bronzing drop for my skin tone, it helps warm up my too light foundations.

I tried a sample that came with my order. This feels nice on and looks good. Glowy, without being shiny. I have sensitive skin and this was fine for me. After wearing it for a while, it started to show off pores a bit. I wasn't bothered by how it smells.I was very confused though by the back of the sample saying "for cosmetic purposes only. Not intended for sunscreen protection." ….isn't the product literally called sunscreen?

avis.titre: Perfect Tinted Sunscreen for Daily Use
avis.texte: I typically do not wear daily makeup except for mascara and lip gloss. This is perfect to help cover up some blemishes while providing uv protection and help with oil control in my tzone area.

I received a free product to try. It has a fun bottle shape that is unique. The product smells nice no lingering smell to contend with and it doesn't pill of like some sunscreen do. Overall works well

Hands down my favorite SPF I have ever used. I prep with Ilia's milky toner & my daily moisturizer, then layer this SPF on top. It applies extremely well. In the past, using my previous tinted SPF would leave me very greasy by the end of my work day which was so annoying. This product has kept me looking glowy but NOT greasy! My skin feels so much better. It truly does work & has made me so happy. This product has very little coverage, but I realized that this was making my skin look so good all by itself that I am no longer need additional coverage for every day looks! Just a touch of Ilia's concealer for a more polished look. I will 100% be repurchasing & highly recommend this product.
This is so easy to apply, and does not leave you feeling greasy. I love using it. It leaves me hydrated, and makes my skin look really good. Did not cause any irritation.

I really liked this sunscreen. It feels nice on the skin, goes on smoothly, and doesn't feel heavy on my face. I also like that the tint looks natural and leaves my skin looking more even and cared for.

avis.titre: Lightweight serum, with no white cast
avis.texte: I love the texture of this lightweight, non-greasy feeling serum from ILIA. It goes on smoothly, and feels more like "skincare" than sunscreen. It does a great job of blending quickly, leaving no white cast behind because it blends invisibly. It's quite hydrating, and it definitely works to keep the "shine" under control for hours without drying out my skin. I love that it's a clean beauty product.

I purchased light to medium, and while I like the texture, it turned me a bit orange. I wish there was a true light color available. Plus it stained towels and clothing orange too. If it didn't turn so much darker on my skin, I would like it more.
Great product! Feels like you have nothing on your skin. I like the subtle tint. I think it's a great product for the warmer months. Will purchase again.
Thank you Pinchme for the free sample! It's not bad, but it's not my favorite, but it would be great to wear on the beach or somewhere similar where SPF 50 is extremely necessary.

This was in impulse purchase--I was looking to replace my current SPF facial product from another company because one of the ingredients was irritating my rosacea. I'm blown away by how nice this feels on my face, and my skin actually looks kinda bouncy whilst wearing it?? (At age 51, it's always a pleasant surprise to be thrilled with my skin!) I could see this layering well under makeup. I'm planning to make this my daily "foundation" and only using spot concealer on my face where necessary. It looks like my skin but better and doesn't hide the freckles I've come to love. Seriously considering setting up a regular auto ship for this product so I can get it monthly.

The Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 is my new favorite. It feels light and blends into my skin nicely. The coverage gives my skin a natural fresh appearance. The small bottle is nice but also only has 1.52 ounces so it's not a lot of sunscreen.

avis.titre: Natural, sun kissed look with no sun damage!
avis.texte: I get huge splotchy freckles with sun exposure, so I love the high SPF of Sun Serum. It prevents the spots, and applies, and absorbs, beautifully. Since I can't tan, I bought a cool tone a few shades darker than my normal cool skin color. Now I apply Sun Serum every morning for a natural looking sun-kissed "tan" with none of the sun damage! It's a win in so many ways. Thank you Ilia!

I've hunted a few years for daily use spf that doesn't irritate my very sensitive skin, and doesn't feel like a mask on my face. This is it! The slight tint is a bonus as it adds warmth to my face, like a happy day out in the sun.

I did loved this sun serum but unfortunately I got the wrong color for my complexion and it was too dark but the results are awesome. Very easy to use, blended into my skin and left me protected and not shiny or greasy which I always do when I wear sunscreen. Makes my skin feel very healthy,. No I need to get another one in the right color for me!
Love this mineral sunscreen. It's cute and small and a dream to apply. Does not mess up makeup. It's lovely.

avis.titre: Love the Product, Not the Packaging
avis.texte: Love the formula — lightweight, natural-looking, and fragrance-free. It wears really nicely throughout the day and blends well with other products. But the packaging drives me crazy. The lid is SO hard to open and hasn't gotten easier with use. Great product, but very frustrating design.
Easy to apply..Very smooth blends well I use daily makes my skin feel softer too.

New to this product and don't have tons of experience to report on, but it feels great on and does deliver on the matte finish. Seems to hold up to the standard of the other ilia products. I would just say not a big fan of the round packaging. It makes it hard for me to tell how much is left. With other tinted sunscreens, I can either feel through the packaging or when I shake it can tell how much I have been using and how much is left.

This makeup sunscreen was really good. Just was a bit too dark for my shade. It definitely works great with the 50 spf. Face is saved pretty much all day. Smooth texture finish like a creamy concealer.

I reviewed the ILIA Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 with 8-Hour Oil Control for free in exchange for an honest review. I received the shade Sun Serum - Light and was honestly impressed with how well it blended into my skin. If I didn't know it was a sunscreen product, I probably wouldn't have guessed because it applied so smoothly and naturally. It also had significantly less shine compared to other serum products I've tried, which I appreciated. My only con is that it did feel a little tacky on my skin after application, but overall it wore nicely throughout the day.

avis.titre: Mineral SPF That Doesn't Feel Gross
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of mineral sunscreens and most either feel heavy, make me shiny by noon, or pill under makeup. This one actually controls oil without making my skin feel dry or tight. It goes on smoothly, blends better than most mineral SPFs, and wears really well throughout the day. I also appreciate that it doesn't have that thick sunscreen smell or greasy finish. My skin still looked like skin, just less oily. I've been reaching for it daily, which says a lot because I'm usually pretty picky about sunscreen textures.
Nice clean product that didn't leave me oily or feeling sticky. Also did not make me breakout, will be adding to my routine!

I've used this sunscreen for a few days and thus far love the way it feels on my skin. It does not work like a foundation to cover redness or age spots (almost 70 years) for me, but I definitely like that it is a lightweight product with a hint of color with a very good SPF. Great to use before walking my dog or running out for the day with "no makeup" but a clean sunscreen.

I wish I knew how to best rate this. I absolutely love this product. I love how light weight and easy it goes on. I enjoy that I only need to add a little concealer and mascara, and I feel like I'm good for the day. This is the only review I've ever done in my life for any item. I truly love this product. The only downside for me is that I feel like it gets a little orange-ish throughout the day. For reference, I do have a extremely pale, rosacea prone skin. If this product could come either in a color lighter, or be worn without turning kind of orange, it'd be perfect for my skin.

I love this sun serum! I am very particular of what skincare I use. For the last two weeks I have applied sun serum faithfully. It has been over 90 degrees and the humidity is miserable! This serum not only looked great but felt great on my skin. The serum feels very light and looks beautiful on me. When I first applied it it was shiny however within 2-3 minutes it goes to a very skin like finish except prettier!
I love this sunscreen. The color is light with almost no color visible and it leaves a beautiful glow. It's not greasy at all but your skin feels moisturized.

avis.titre: It's hard to believe this is sunscreen!
avis.texte: Feels like a moisturizer. It's amazing on my skin. My skin is very sensitive and there is no reaction. It's soft quickly absorbs and doesn't sit on top of my skin. Is by far my favorite sunscreen.
Ilia Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen is a great tinted sunscreen. It goes on smoothly with light coverage and absorbs facial oil. I received a free product in exchange for my honest review.

I tried the ILIA Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 with 8-Hour Oil Control and was impressed by how lightweight it felt compared to most mineral sunscreens. It blended into my skin better than expected and didn't leave the heavy greasy feeling that usually makes me question every skincare decision I've ever made. I also liked that it helped control shine throughout the day while still feeling hydrating. The coverage held up well in the Arizona heat, and my skin felt comfortable even after hours of wear. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

This is a nice formula , nice under makeup as well. I have dry skin and the only drawback to this product is that it is very drying on your face. Oily skinned people will just love this product. I will continue using this product. I love that it is fragrance free!

avis.titre: Must have in your daily life!!!
avis.texte: The best one I can just tell you 😍✨✨ your skin needs this and come back later to thank me. You can see the difference in your skin in just a few days after.
It worked amazing, but I'm not a big fan of the aroma. I have a issue with sun poisoning being diabetic and this did seem to help my face from drying out due to the sun. Highly recommend it
It looks very nice on instead of washing me out. The skin looks silky. No adverse effects.
Is the only sunscreen that I can wear daily and not break out. Please don't ever discontinue it!

I wanted to try this sunscreen so much as I love the ILIA super serum tint and that's what I normally wear but wanted something with less coverage. This is awesome, lightweight, doesn't make me break out, it is moisturizing and doesn't sting around eyes - I'm pretty sensitive to that, most sunscreen bother my eyes so I have to apply really far from them.... Very happy with this purchase, another product staple for me

I've been using the ILIA Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50, and it's quickly become one of those rare sunscreens that actually feels like skincare. The water‑burst texture is the standout — it goes on like a lightweight serum, sinks in immediately, and doesn't leave the usual mineral cast. On my skin, it dries down to a soft, natural finish that isn't greasy or heavy. The 8‑hour oil control claim holds up surprisingly well. By mid‑day, I'm usually shiny, but this keeps me noticeably more balanced without feeling drying. The hydration is also legit — ILIA advertises up to 24 hours, and while I'm not timing it, my skin never feels tight or chalky the way some mineral SPFs can.
